fichas.h1: Cristallino for Pirelli Tempered Glass Foosball Table by Teckell
fichas.descripcion:
The Cristallino for Pirelli is a limited-edition glass foosball table designed by Adriano Design for Teckell, built on a 5/8" low iron tempered glass structure with a black Corian® playing field. Made in Italy.

RACING DETAILS

The playing field carries curved yellow markings drawn from Pirelli branding, and the anodized aluminum handles repeat the tread of the P ZERO™ tire. Ends have rubber inserts modeled after motorsport tires; scoring units are chrome-plated brass.

PLAY AND PLACEMENT

  • Telescopic rods in AISI 316 stainless steel with self-lubricating bearings for fast, nearly silent movement.
  • Fully rubber Pirelli-branded feet adjust to uneven surfaces.
  • For indoors and covered outdoor use.
  • Teckell® Tool Kit: Certificate of Authenticity, assembly tools, instructions and lubricant.

At 55 1/8" W x 68 1/2" D x 36 1/4" H (with rods), the table needs clear depth for rod travel, so measure the space before you commit. Compare it with our other foosball tables.
fichas.descripcion_original:
A striking collaboration between two icons of Italian excellence, this limited-edition foosball table by Teckell and Pirelli fuses design innovation with motorsport heritage. Refined, bold, and unmistakably premium, it brings together the precision of high-performance engineering and the craftsmanship of luxury interiors. Every detail pays homage to Pirelli’s legacy in racing, creating a piece that is as visually dynamic as it is functionally flawless.

Luxury foosball table with structure in 5/8" low iron tempered glass, featuring beveled and cerium oxide-polished corners. The long glass side displays a branded identification plate with both Pirelli and Teckell logos. The playing field is made from sleek black Corian®, enhanced with custom curved yellow markings inspired by Pirelli’s iconic branding.

Handles are crafted from anodized aluminum and designed with a graphic motif that echoes the tread of the new Pirelli P ZERO™ tire. The ends feature rubber inserts modeled after top-tier motorsport tires, offering superior grip and tactile control. The quick-mount system ensures a precise fit and easy replacement.

Scoring units are made from chrome-plated brass, with end pieces proudly displaying both Teckell and Pirelli branding. Joints are made of brass, finished in matte black paint for a sportier, more contemporary look.

Telescopic rods are crafted from AISI 316 stainless steel, with rod ends featuring dual-layer shock absorption. Self-lubricating bearings allow for smooth, fast, and nearly silent movement. The table stands on fully rubber feet, branded with the Pirelli logo and adjustable to accommodate uneven surfaces.

The Teckell® Tool Kit includes a Certificate of Authenticity, assembly tools, detailed instructions, and a specialized lubricant for optimal game flow.

Designed for indoor and covered outdoor use, this collector’s piece embodies the spirit of speed, design, and Italian craftsmanship.

Made in Italy.

fichas.h1: Saba Blown Glass Ceiling Lamp by Vistosi
fichas.descripcion:
The Saba is a satin-finish blown-glass ceiling lamp designed by the Vistosi Technical Studio for Vistosi. Its lens-like shape sits close to the mounting surface and can also serve as a wall fixture. Made in Italy.

SIZES AND LIGHT OUTPUT

  • Four diameters: Ø11 7/8" x 3 1/2" H, Ø15 3/4" x 4" H, Ø19 5/8" x 5 1/2" H, and Ø22 3/8" x 6" H.
  • LED options: LED 0 - 26W - 3700lm, LED F - 12W - 1700lm, and LED G - 19W - 2850lm.
  • Color temperature: 2700 K or 3000 K. Dimming: DIM2 (Phase Cut) or DIM3 (0-10V / 1-10V / PUSH).

WHERE IT FITS

Choose the diameter by ceiling height and area: the 11 7/8" version is 3 1/2" high, while the 22 3/8" version is 6" high. The lamp can also be mounted on a wall. For low-ceilinged living rooms, modern kitchens, or corridors, its lens-like form keeps it close to the mounting surface. Compare it with other ceiling lamps.
fichas.descripcion_original: Designed by the Vistosi Technical Studio, the Saba is a handcrafted masterpiece of Italian design, created to star in the most exclusive contemporary interiors. This ceiling lamp—which doubles as a wall fixture—is defined by its essential, lens-like shape that sits discreetly against the mounting surface. It reflects a luxury lifestyle where light is used to create a calm, atmospheric presence; the satin-finish blown glass diffuser provides a warm, glare-free glow that transitions smoothly across its cambered surface. Its timeless and versatile aesthetic makes it a sophisticated choice for low-ceilinged living rooms, modern kitchens, or elegant corridors. Made in Italy.
